citation.title: Applications of a novel model-based real-time observer for electron density profile control experiments in TCV
citation.authors: F. Pastore, O. Sauter, F. Felici, D. Kropackova, et al.
citation.doi_or_arxiv: 10.1088/1741-4326/aeab66 (this paper's own DOI, from the cover page; reference-list DOIs belong to cited works)

scope_read.pdf_pages: 1-38 (cover plus manuscript pp.1-37, with Appendices A-C and figures)
scope_read.limitations: Accepted manuscript, not the Version of Record. The arXiv preprint was not supplied.

claim_checks.proposed_claim: A multi-rate observer was run in real time in closed-loop control on TCV.
claim_checks.source_finding: An EKF fusing FIR every 1 ms with RT-TS at nominally 60 Hz runs in the TCV PCS (SCD). It feeds PI gas controllers via SAMONE. Experiments controlled line-averaged density inside the LCFS, central density, and edge-density fraction together with beta.
claim_checks.allowed_intro_sentence: Model-based multi-rate observers that fuse fast line-integrated interferometry with slower, spatially resolved Thomson scattering have supplied electron-density estimates to feedback controllers inside the TCV control system [Pastore2026].
claim_checks.qualification: Electron density only, on TCV. Agreement is judged against offline TS, and TS is also an observer input. Evidence is per-shot examples, not aggregate statistics.

claim_checks.proposed_claim: The observer detects and corrects diagnostic faults.
claim_checks.source_finding: Innovation residuals drive an additive FIR offset correction, using the TS-updated state; this addresses SOL pickup and fringe jumps. Edge FIR chords are down-weighted. Fringe-jumped FIR chords #8 and #9, which were not used in the EKF, are reconstructed synthetically. A model-convergence failure produced a transient underestimate that recovered at the next TS sample.
claim_checks.locator: PDF p.6 Sec.2.1 Eqs.(5)-(6); p.8 Sec.3 footnote 3; p.25 Fig.21; p.24-25 Sec.6.2 Fig.22d; p.28 App.A Fig.A.23
claim_checks.allowed_intro_sentence: In such observers, innovation residuals and a forward diagnostic model have been used to correct interferometer offsets and to reconstruct channels corrupted by fringe jumps in example discharges [Pastore2026].
claim_checks.qualification: Demonstrated in illustrative shots only. Fault-handling accuracy is not quantified, and the estimator itself can fail (non-convergence).

claim_checks.proposed_claim: Differences between the journal and preprint versions.
claim_checks.source_finding: Only the journal accepted manuscript was read.
claim_checks.qualification: No version comparison is possible from the supplied material.

input_target_timing.inputs: FIR line integrals (digitized at 200 kHz, filtered to 10 kHz, used every 1 ms); RT-TS ne profiles (60 Hz nominal, 40 Hz in shot #82876); RT-LIUQE equilibrium at 1 kHz; gas-valve readback; ML-derived L/H boolean
input_target_timing.outputs: ne(rho) spline state; derived NEL_LCFS, ne(0), ne(0.7) and synthetic FIR signals; TS-derived nu/D and FIR offsets held by zero-order hold between TS samples
input_target_timing.causal_or_offline: Causal online filtering. Profile comparisons, the fixed-vs-adaptive nu/D study (Fig.15) and the boundary-condition study (App.B) are offline reruns on stored RT data.
input_target_timing.source_diagnostic_as_input: Yes. RT-TS both constrains the estimate and serves, as offline TS, as the comparison reference.
input_target_timing.reported_vs_physical_truth: Offline TS fits are treated as the reference. They are not independent truth.

validation.split_unit: not_applicable (no train/test split). D profile and covariances are heuristically tuned and fixed across shots. Gains were tuned using stored RT signals from earlier shots.
validation.temporal_order: Online causal filter; offline reanalysis afterwards
validation.unknowns: Aggregate error metrics, total shot count, TS arrival latency, uncertainty intervals

runtime_or_deployment.what_was_measured: Authors state the profile output is computed in under 1 ms, with a 1 ms update cycle. Closed-loop operation is shown in several discharges.
runtime_or_deployment.what_not_established: Latency distributions, measured TS report arrival times, fault-detection statistics, generalization beyond TCV

forbidden_inferences: Says nothing about CES or carbon ion temperature, KSTAR, or BES/ECEI inputs
Does not nowcast a pending diagnostic report
The authors' 'first' and 'novel' wording is their own claim and must not be repeated as fact
Do not attribute its timing figures to our study
GENE pumpout analysis concerns TCV density transport and does not transfer as a mechanism to our setting
Do not imply that prior observers are noncausal or electrons-only
competing_or_complementary: Complementary. It fills the gaps between slow local reports using a physics model plus a fast integral diagnostic, holding the TS-derived quantities between samples; this conceptually parallels our hold and nowcast comparisons. Its targets and inputs differ from ours.
